scope_note: On 2026-10-15 agent review inspected current main, recent merges including refreshed reference-admission audits, repository instructions, task ownership, schemas, coverage, source identities, existing salinity records and validators. Read the primary Frontiers article by Hershkowitz, Westmoreland and Bugbee (published 2025-02-20), including Abstract and Materials and methods. Enriched one root-zone/salinity profile with one new source identity and three exact claims: bounded T1 nutrient-input treatment context, symptom-negative accumulation result, and refill-solution versus root-zone measurement distinction. Added a structured negative-comparison step. These experiments are not NaCl challenge, universal safe EC limits, visual absence proof of acceptable chemistry, or new diagnosed images. Existing 0.20 photo-only ceiling, chemistry linkage, human-review flags and media/training exclusions remain. No new images, videos, licenses or source-asset references; existing two diagrams remain reference-only. Totals: 63 profiles, 192 sources, 89 media references, 35 originals plus 68 crops (103 persisted images), zero training-eligible media. Source DOI occurs once in the exported catalog. Initial tests exposed a stale three-source expectation; an overly broad patch briefly touched the analogous root-binding assertion, which was restored. Targeted 30-test coverage run then passed. Final clean full verification passed all 62 package validators, 288 tests, type check, build, frozen-artifact byte verification and diff checks. Receipt/claim validators rerun after receipt creation. PHP unavailable locally and remains a hosted requirement. Deterministic exports and model-data fingerprint pins updated; 191 frozen text-training rows do not imply a model run or image admission. Independent symptom-linked imagery, longitudinal videos, controls and causal/analytical confirmation remain gaps. Agent review is not human/expert/lab review; no deployment or overall project completion claimed.
